top_findings.title: team_stats double-counts cross-file duplicate fixtures (~2x W/L/D and goals)
top_findings.evidence: src/brazilian_soccer_mcp/core.clj:108 team-stats calls (search-matches db (assoc criteria :limit 100000)) then record-for, with NO unique-fixtures dedup — unlike standings (core.clj:142) which wraps search-matches in unique-fixtures (core.clj:127). Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv both carry all 38 Flamengo-2019 fixtures (verified: 38 rows each; e.g. 2019-04-27 Flamengo 3-1 Cruzeiro present in both). date-key/team-key normalize them to the identical identity tuple [2019 "2019-04-27" "flamengo" "cruzeiro" 3 1], so team_stats Flamengo/2019/Brasileirao returns matches=76 (2x the correct 38). Tests never catch this: core_test.clj:14-18 exercise team-stats only on a synthetic 3-match db with no cross-file duplicates.
top_findings.suggestion: Wrap the search-matches call in team-stats with unique-fixtures, exactly as standings does at core.clj:142.

top_findings.title: head_to_head inflated by the same un-deduped fixture path
top_findings.evidence: src/brazilian_soccer_mcp/core.clj:114 head-to-head calls (search-matches db (merge criteria {...:limit 100000})) and reduces over the raw result with no unique-fixtures — the identical un-deduped path proven to double team_stats. Any H2H whose fixtures appear in >1 supplied file (any Brasileirao pairing 2003-2019, where Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv overlap) is over-counted ~2x, and :matches (count matches) at core.clj:118 doubles too. Tests only exercise head-to-head on the synthetic db (core_test.clj:18), so the bug is untested.
top_findings.suggestion: Wrap the search-matches call in head-to-head with unique-fixtures (core.clj:127), matching standings.
